--- Historical v0.2 validation follows ---

ooRexx Work Load Units v0.2 validation
======================================

Runtime used
------------
Open Object Rexx 5.3.0 r13196, 64-bit debug/internal test build supplied by the user.

Core invariants exercised
-------------------------
- WLU remains a normalized work quantity; WLU/s remains a separate delivery-capacity quantity.
- Acceleration/throttling changes WLU/s without multiplying reserved or actual WLU.
- Mandatory account, burst and throughput constraints are selected by authority policy.
- Failed admission causes no consumer/account reservation side effect.
- Internal reservation and job-budget proofs use SipHash-2-4-128; durable ledger checkpoints retain an Ed25519 boundary.
- Rate-card generation is retained across live policy changes.
- Terminal capacity denial occurs before terminal mutation.

Logical-job / budget invariants added in v0.2
---------------------------------------------
- One business job/session owns one authenticated WLU budget across implementation changes.
- Script, Gemma, Grok and OpenAI execution stages do not mint independent copies of the parent budget.
- Explicit handoff/context-rehydration allowance is included in the target stage's demand.
- Fallback branches are mutually exclusive alternatives; strategy ceiling uses the maximum declared successor path.
- Parent budget reports FULL_STRATEGY or PARTIAL_STRATEGY coverage rather than implying unavailable rescue routes are guaranteed.
- spent + committed + remaining == hard job budget.
- Child reservations are carved from remaining parent budget and still pass through normal WLU authority admission.
- Replacement stages may be reserved before an old stage is released (make-before-break).
- Releasing a partially consumed old stage preserves observed work in parent spent WLU and refunds only unused commitment.
- A stale authenticated parent lease cannot mint additional child work.
- Fallback assessment is side-effect free and reports both parent-budget viability and live enterprise capacity viability.

FlyLo / Shannon executable scenario
-----------------------------------
Plan:
  SCRIPT -> GEMMA -> { GROK | OPENAI }

Declared ceilings:
  SCRIPT: 2 WLU
  GEMMA: 6 WLU execution + 1 WLU handoff = 7 WLU
  GROK: 9 WLU execution + 2 WLU handoff = 11 WLU
  OPENAI: 12 WLU execution + 3 WLU handoff = 15 WLU

Maximum declared fallback path:
  SCRIPT + GEMMA + OPENAI = 24 WLU

Test job budget:
  20 WLU -> PARTIAL_STRATEGY

After 1 WLU actual SCRIPT work and 5 WLU actual GEMMA work:
  spent = 6 WLU
  remaining = 14 WLU
  GROK 11-WLU ceiling -> viable
  OPENAI 15-WLU ceiling -> WLU job-budget shortfall of 1 WLU
